changeSet.sql: COMMENT ON SCHEMA submission_review IS 'Submission review (docs/features/submission-review): conflicts and their phone copies. Never part of the analytics copy.'

CREATE TABLE submission_review.conflict ( id varchar(36) NOT NULL, submission_id varchar(26) NOT NULL, uploader_user_id varchar(26) NOT NULL, state varchar(16) NOT NULL, cause varchar(32) NOT NULL, base_version bigint, rows_lack_ids boolean NOT NULL, upload_route varchar(16) NOT NULL, phone_copy jsonb NOT NULL, first_received_at timestamptz NOT NULL, last_received_at timestamptz NOT NULL, resend_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, decided_at timestamptz, decided_by_user_id varchar(26), decision_reason text, reapplied_edits boolean, accepted_version bigint, CONSTRAINT pk_conflict PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT fk_conflict_submission FOREIGN KEY (submission_id) REFERENCES public.data_submission (id), CONSTRAINT fk_conflict_uploader FOREIGN KEY (uploader_user_id) REFERENCES public.app_user (id), CONSTRAINT fk_conflict_decided_by FOREIGN KEY (decided_by_user_id) REFERENCES public.app_user (id), CONSTRAINT ck_conflict_state CHECK (state IN ('OPEN', 'KEPT', 'ACCEPTED')), CONSTRAINT ck_conflict_cause CHECK (cause IN ('SERVER_SIDE_CHANGE', 'DETECTION_ERROR')), -- A conflict detection opened knows its base version; only a failed detection may not. CONSTRAINT ck_conflict_base CHECK ( (base_version IS NOT NULL AND base_version >= 0) OR cause = 'DETECTION_ERROR'), CONSTRAINT ck_conflict_upload_route CHECK (upload_route IN ('VERSIONED', 'LEGACY')), CONSTRAINT ck_conflict_received CHECK ( last_received_at >= first_received_at AND resend_count >= 0 AND version >= 0), -- An OPEN conflict has no decision; a decided one says who, when and why; only an accept says whether it -- re-applied the server-side edits and which submission version it made. CONSTRAINT ck_conflict_decision CHECK ( CASE state WHEN 'OPEN' THEN num_nonnulls(decided_at, decided_by_user_id, decision_reason, reapplied_edits, accepted_version) = 0 WHEN 'KEPT' THEN num_nonnulls(decided_at, decided_by_user_id, decision_reason) = 3 AND num_nonnulls(reapplied_edits, accepted_version) = 0 WHEN 'ACCEPTED' THEN num_nonnulls(decided_at, decided_by_user_id, decision_reason, reapplied_edits, accepted_version) = 5 ELSE true END) )
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_conflict_open ON submission_review.conflict (submission_id, uploader_user_id) WHERE state = 'OPEN'
CREATE INDEX idx_conflict_submission_uploader ON submission_review.conflict (submission_id, uploader_user_id)
